fields.ic_name: USB4 (USB Implementers Forum, Intel Thunderbolt 3 base)

channels.name: SBU1/SBU2
channels.purpose: Sideband management channel between adjacent routers.

channels.name: CC1/CC2
channels.purpose: USB-C Configuration Channel; USB Power Delivery + orientation.

channels.name: VBUS
channels.purpose: Bus power per negotiated PD contract (up to 100 W / 240 W EPR).

logical_signaling_levels.name: LT-LFPS
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Low-Frequency Periodic Signaling ordered sets for link training.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Electrical idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Lanes quiescent when link up but no traffic.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Gen4 PAM-3
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: USB4 v2 multilevel signalling for 80 Gbps.

global_signals.name: VBUS
global_signals.purpose: Bus power per the USB Power Delivery contract.

dependency_graph.common_rule: The Connection Manager (host-resident) configures all routers; tunnels are set up before traffic flows; routers forward tunneled + control packets per their installed path config.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each tunnel = an end-to-end path = an ordered list of per-hop {adapter, hop ID} entries; transport uses credit-based flow control between adjacent routers.

handshake_pairs.name: LFPS-train
handshake_pairs.rule: LT-LFPS ordered sets train + bond the high-speed lanes.

handshake_pairs.name: Credit-flow
handshake_pairs.rule: Credit-based flow control gates transport-layer data.

handshake_pairs.name: Config-rd/wr
handshake_pairs.rule: CM reads capabilities + writes path config.

handshake_pairs.name: PD-negotiate
handshake_pairs.rule: USB Power Delivery contract on CC pins before high-power VBUS.

handshake_pairs.name: TMU-sync
handshake_pairs.rule: Time Management Unit distributes a common time base.

ordering_rules.per_tunnel_ordering: Each tunnel preserves the native protocol's packet ordering end-to-end.
ordering_rules.transport_flow_control: Credit-based; no reorder across a single path.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Full-duplex; independent TX and RX pairs per lane.
